postings.title: Account Executive, Korea
postings.description:
Make Your Mark

Cymulate’s Continuous Security Validation enables companies to challenge, assess and optimize their cyber-security posture against the evolving cyberthreat landscape, simply and continuously.

With world-class clients we strive to bring the highest level of service to everything we do. Our team is made up of the very best people for the job and as we grow, we’re always on the lookout for people with the skills, experience, and personality that will let us both shine. With high scores on Gartner, G2 and Glassdoor, our clients and employees have let us know what they love about us.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

- Own the Korea territory and drive new business growth.

- Hunt, prospect, and build pipeline across mid-market and enterprise accounts.

- Consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets.

- Break into strategic accounts and build relationships with CISOs and senior security leaders.

- Run the full sales cycle from first touch through negotiation and close.

- Build and execute territory plans that create pipeline and accelerate revenue.

- Leverage channel partners, field events, and internal resources to win business.

- Maintain accurate forecasts, pipeline, and opportunity data in Salesforce.

WHAT YOU WILL HAVE:

- 5+ years of cybersecurity, enterprise software, or SaaS sales experience.

- A proven track record of exceeding quota in a high-growth, hunting-focused role.

- Strong new-logo acquisition and pipeline generation experience.

- Experience closing complex enterprise deals with technical and executive buyers.

- Strong knowledge of the Korea cybersecurity market and channel ecosystem.

- Existing relationships with CISOs and senior security leaders in Korea.

- Competitive, driven, resilient, and highly accountable.

- Strong negotiation, communication, and executive presence.

- Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, or similar sales tools.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will take full ownership of building and growing our business in the German market, with the potential to expand your responsibility across the broader DACH region. You will develop the territory from the ground up, create your own pipeline, and lead complex cybersecurity sales cycles from initial engagement through negotiation and close.

This is a high-impact role for a genuine hunter who combines strong self-sourcing capabilities, disciplined sales execution, and established relationships within the German cybersecurity ecosystem.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

- Own the German Market: Take full responsibility for new business growth across Germany, with the potential to expand your scope across DACH.

- Build the Territory: Develop and execute a clear territory plan, including account mapping, target prioritization, pipeline creation, partner engagement, and strategic account penetration.

- Generate Your Own Pipeline: Proactively hunt, prospect, and create opportunities across enterprise accounts without relying primarily on SDR-, marketing-, or partner-generated leads.

- Win New Enterprise Customers: Break into strategic accounts and build trusted relationships with CISOs, security executives, and other key decision-makers.

- Manage Complex Sales Cycles: Lead the full sales process from first engagement through discovery, evaluation, business case development, procurement, legal, negotiation, and close.

- Engage Multiple Stakeholders: Navigate buying committees involving CISOs, SecOps, SOC teams, detection engineering, procurement, legal, and executive leadership.

- Apply Structured Qualification: Use a consistent methodology such as MEDDPICC to qualify opportunities, identify risks, build champions, and drive deals forward.

- Leverage the Partner Ecosystem: Build and activate relationships with channel partners, resellers, MSSPs, and security consulting organizations to create and accelerate opportunities.

- Deliver Predictable Results: Consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets while maintaining personal accountability for pipeline coverage and revenue outcomes.

- Maintain Forecasting Discipline: Provide accurate forecasts and maintain complete, reliable pipeline and opportunity data in Salesforce.

- Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and leadership to win strategic business and support long-term customer success.

WHAT YOU WILL HAVE:

- 5+ years of enterprise sales experience in cybersecurity, enterprise software, or SaaS, including significant experience selling in Germany.

- A documented track record of achieving or exceeding quota and winning new enterprise customers in the German market.

- Strong self-sourcing and new-logo acquisition capabilities, with the ability to build pipeline independently.

- Experience managing complex cybersecurity sales cycles involving technical, commercial, legal, procurement, and executive stakeholders.

- Strong cybersecurity market knowledge and experience selling to CISOs, SecOps leaders, SOC teams, and other senior security stakeholders.

- Established relationships with enterprise customers, channel partners, resellers, MSSPs, and security consulting organizations in Germany.

- Practical experience using a structured qualification methodology such as MEDDPICC.

- Strong territory planning, opportunity management, forecasting, and CRM discipline.

- Previous experience succeeding in a cybersecurity startup or scale-up environment.

- A competitive, driven, resilient, and highly accountable mindset.

- Strong negotiation, communication, and executive presence.

- Fluent German and English communication skills.

Flexible Employment Setup: This role will be offered through an employment arrangement outside our German legal entity, with full details shared during the interview process.

postings.title: Field Marketing Manager, APJ
postings.description:

We are looking for a passionate and versatile Field Marketing Manager in APJ to join our team and lead regional field marketing initiatives across the Asia-Pacific and Japan region. Based in Singapore, this is a high-impact individual contributor role where you will be responsible for building and executing programs that engage enterprise security leaders, generate qualified pipeline, accelerate deal velocity, and elevate Cymulate’s brand presence in continuous automated security validation and exposure management.

You will own regional field marketing programs across key target markets (including South East Asia, Korea, Greater China, Japan, and Australia), shaping how Cymulate shows up in the region. While operating independently day-to-day as the strategic marketing partner to the VP of Sales APJ, you will be supported by a collaborative global marketing team, local sales leadership, and cross-functional partners invested in your success.

This role requires exceptional attention to detail, organization, and follow-through. The ideal candidate is resourceful, highly accountable, commercially minded, and thrives in a fast-paced cybersecurity environment while managing multiple programs, channel activations, and logistics streams simultaneously.

What You Will Do:

- Plan and execute integrated field marketing programs across APJ, including C-level executive roundtables, VIP dinners, technical workshops, industry trade shows (e.g., GovWare, regional cyber summits), partner days, and Cymulate-owned activations that directly support pipeline and revenue targets.

- Own event logistics and operations from start to finish, including budget tracking, venue sourcing, vendor negotiation, booth design, AV setup, regional shipments, onsite execution, premium swag management, and structured post-event workflows.

- Partner closely with the VP of Sales APJ, regional account executives, and the global demand generation team to align on territory goals, drive qualified attendance, accelerate pipeline progression, and ensure measurable ROI.

- Collaborate with sales on target enterprise account lists (financial services, government, critical infrastructure, MSSPs) to orchestrate hyper-targeted pre-event outreach and high-touch field campaigns.

- Work alongside regional distributors, value-added resellers (VARs), and system integrators across Singapore, ASEAN, and ANZ to co-plan and deliver joint webinars, lunch-and-learns, and sponsored partner events.

- Execute digital components that power field initiatives, including localized landing pages, invitation workflows, email sequences, registration portals, and sales follow-up cadences.

- Track and report on program performance, including attendee qualification, MQL-to-SQL conversion, sales follow-up velocity, pipeline creation, and cost efficiency, providing data-driven insights to refine regional marketing strategy.

What You Will Need:

- 4+ years of experience in field marketing, partner marketing, or event operations within a high-growth B2B enterprise software or cybersecurity environment in APJ.

- Proven ability to plan and execute events end to end, including venue coordination, vendor management, registration, onsite execution, and post-event follow-up.

- Solid understanding of enterprise IT/security buyer dynamics and channel landscapes in Singapore, ASEAN, and ANZ.

- Comfortable collaborating closely with sales teams to support outreach, prospecting, and pipeline initiatives.

- Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple programs and deadlines simultaneously.

- Comfortable managing shipments, show services, AV coordination, swag, branded materials, and onsite logistics.

- Excellent communicator who thrives in cross-functional work across sales, marketing, product, design, and leadership.

- Strong cross-functional communication skills; capable of operating with high autonomy, proactive problem-solving, and accountability in a regional hub.

- Willingness to travel regionally across Asia Pacific and Japan (~20–25%) for major trade shows, partner events, and regional activations.

As a Pre-sales Cybersecurity Engineer, you will be a key technical resource for our sales teams, helping to bridge the gap between complex cybersecurity solutions and customer needs. You will work closely with sales teams, product teams, and customers throughout the entire sales cycle— from initial engagement through proof of concept (PoC), to post-sales success. Your expertise will guide the sales process by providing in-depth technical knowledge, addressing customer concerns, and ensuring the solutions we propose meet their unique security needs.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

- Customer Presentations & Demonstrations: Create and deliver technical presentations and product demos to customers, highlighting how our solutions address their cybersecurity challenges.

- Proof of Concept (PoC): Lead and execute PoC activities, guiding customers through setup, configuration, and testing to demonstrate the value of our solutions.

- Sales Support: Serve as the primary technical contact for customers during the sales cycle. Collaborate with sales teams to identify and qualify sales opportunities.

- Customer Relationship Management: Build and manage strong technical relationships with customers, ensuring smooth handoffs to the Customer Success Team post-sale and continued technical support throughout the customer journey.

- Technical Advice: Advise sales, development, and leadership teams on technical aspects, answering questions and providing expert input to support the sales process.

- Product Feedback: Provide timely and actionable feedback from customers to the Product Development team, helping to shape future product roadmaps and improvements.

- Industry Engagement: Represent the company at trade shows, channel events, and industry conferences, promoting our product portfolio and fostering relationships within the cybersecurity community.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED:

- 2-5 years in a pre-sales cybersecurity role, with a strong understanding of the cybersecurity landscape.

- Familiarity with common cybersecurity tools, attack frameworks, the cyber kill chain, and terminology (e.g., red team, penetration testing, etc.).

- Experience working alongside sales teams through all phases of the sales cycle.

- Comfortable with sales tools such as Salesforce, Zoom, and other collaboration platforms.

- Strong technical understanding of Windows, macOS, and Linux technologies.

WHAT YOU SHOULD HAVE:

- Hands-on Cybersecurity Experience: Experience working with Security Operations Center (SOC), Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Managed Detection and Response (MDR), Network Detection and Response (NDR), vulnerability management, and other cybersecurity tools.

- Specialized Cybersecurity Skills: Knowledge in red-team, blue-team, or purple-team testing, breach and attack simulation, incident response, malware analysis, or other operational cybersecurity domains.

- Networking & Infrastructure: Familiarity with firewalls, web application firewalls, email systems (e.g., Office 365, Gmail), and other networking/infrastructure tools.

- Cloud & Virtualization: Experience with public cloud architectures such as AWS, Azure, GCP, or Oracle Cloud, and knowledge of private/hybrid cloud solutions like VMware, OpenStack, and Nutanix.

- Containerization & DevSecOps: Familiarity with container-based services and application delivery (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker).

Make Your Mark

Cymulate’s Continuous Security Validation enables companies to challenge, assess and optimize their cyber-security posture against the evolving cyberthreat landscape, simply and continuously.

With world-class clients we strive to bring the highest level of service to everything we do. Our team is made up of the very best people for the job and as we grow, we’re always on the lookout for people with the skills, experience, and personality that will let us both shine. With high scores on Gartner, G2 and Glassdoor, our clients and employees have let us know what they love about us.

Cymulate is looking for a Sales Engineer to join our growing APJ team. You’ll be the technical backbone of our enterprise sales motion across the region partnering with Sales, Customer Success, and channel partners to show prospects exactly how Cymulate’s Exposure Validation platform reduces risk in their environment. This is a high-impact, customer-facing role for someone who thrives on solving technical problems live in front of both CISOs and hands-on security teams.

What You Will Do:
• Lead technical discovery, presentations, demonstrations, and Proofs of Concept (PoCs) throughout complex enterprise sales cycles
• Act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, partnering closely with Sales and Customer Success to drive deals to close
• Build and maintain relationships with both security executives and hands-on technical teams
• Design and run in-depth proof-of-value engagements that demonstrate measurable outcomes from the Cymulate platform
• Support and enable channel partners (resellers, MSSPs, distributors) to run their own technical sales motions
• Represent Cymulate at trade shows, technical meetups, and industry events across APJ
• Share customer feedback and technical requirements with Product and R&D to influence the roadmap
• Mentor other Sales Engineers and champion pre-sales best practices across the region
• Stay current on new product features, competitive landscape, and industry developments

What You Will Need:
• 5+ years of pre-sales/sales engineering experience in cybersecurity, delivering solutions to C-level executives at strategic/enterprise accounts
• Proven track record supporting complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles
• Strong knowledge of the cybersecurity landscape, including SOC, SIEM, red teaming, and penetration testing
• Hands-on experience with security tools such as SIEM, EDR/XDR, firewalls, or vulnerability management platforms
• Experience with Breach and Attack Simulation (BAS) or Adversarial Exposure Validation (AEV) strongly preferred
• Working knowledge of Windows, macOS, Linux, networking, and cloud environments (AWS, Azure)
• Familiarity with APIs, MCPs, and AI and security tool integrations
• Excellent presentation and communication skills, equally comfortable whiteboarding with technical teams and briefing security executives
• Ability to travel up to 40% across the APJ region
Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience building or supporting a partner-led technical sales model (GSIs, MSSPs, distributors)
• Track record of delivering world-class demos and training to channel/partner ecosystems
• Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

postings.title: Technical Account Manager
postings.description:
Make Your Mark

Cymulate’s Continuous Security Validation enables companies to challenge, assess and optimize their cyber-security posture against the evolving cyberthreat landscape, simply and continuously.

With world-class clients we strive to bring the highest level of service to everything we do. Our team is made up of the very best people for the job and as we grow, we’re always on the lookout for people with the skills, experience, and personality that will let us both shine. With high scores on Gartner, G2 and Glassdoor, our clients and employees have let us know what they love about us.

Cymulate is the leader in Adversarial Exposure Validation. Our platform lets enterprises test and verifies security controls using real-world attacks, providing clear evidence of their vulnerabilities and assurance that defences are effective.

This is not a standard CSE role. We are looking for a rare combination: someone who can engage at the CISO level on security risk and program strategy in the morning, and go deep on platform configuration, control validation logic, or API integration in the afternoon. You will own the post-sales technical relationship for a portfolio of enterprise and strategic accounts across EMEA, ensuring customers build mature, outcome-driven validation programs that reduce risk and expand over time.

There is a clear and active path to team leadership for the right candidate.

What Will You Do

Enterprise Customer Success

- Own the technical architecture and integration strategy for Enterprise customers from onboarding through long-term adoption

- Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges, integrations, and architecture decisions

- Lead onboarding activities including deployment validation, requirements gathering, and success criteria definition

- Conduct Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) focused on adoption, security posture, and strategic roadmap alignment

- Monitor customer technical health including integrations, governance, and detection maturity

- Drive platform expansion by identifying new use cases and architecting phased rollouts

- Partner closely with Implementation Engineers during onboarding and maintain ongoing architecture governance

Partner & Distributor Enablement

- Enable partners to deliver enterprise-grade implementations and customer success services

- Build and maintain technical enablement materials including architecture guides, troubleshooting playbooks, and best practices

- Deliver technical workshops and certification training sessions for partner technical teams

- Support partners with advanced troubleshooting, escalations, and architectural guidance

- Participate in quarterly partner reviews focused on technical quality and customer satisfaction

- Help partners design scalable managed service and multi-tenant deployment models

- Identify partner skill gaps and develop enablement initiatives to improve delivery quality

What Will You Have

- 10+ years of cybersecurity experience, including 5+ years in customer-facing technical roles such as TAM, Solutions Architect, or Sales Engineer

- Strong hands-on experience with SIEM, XDR/EDR, vulnerability management, threat detection, and exposure management platforms

- Experience designing integrations, APIs, data pipelines, and orchestration workflows

- Strong command-line and troubleshooting skills across Linux, macOS, and Windows environments

- Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code concepts such as Terraform and CloudFormation

- Working knowledge of AWS and/or GCP environments

- Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage both technical teams and executive stakeholders

- Experience leading customer workshops, technical reviews, and strategic discussions

- Strong customer-facing mindset with experience driving retention and expansion opportunities

- Ability to work independently while managing multiple customer and partner relationships

- Security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CEH, OSCP, or equivalent (completed or in progress)

- Experience with Breach & Attack Simulation, MDR, DevSecOps, Cloud Security, or Threat Intelligence is a strong advantage

- Availability to support EMEA customers and occasional travel requirements

- Additional European languages are a plus
